title: Ethiopian Herbes-de-Provence Shiro
description: This egg-free version of the traditional Ethiopian dish features the flavors of herbes-de-provence and the tanginess of nuka-pickle, making it a great option for kids and vegetarians alike. It's a nutty, glassy-jelly-like dish that's perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine nuka-pickle, herbes-de-provence, onion, ginger, garlic, carrots, and zucchini. Blend until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the blended mixture to the saucepan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the nutritional yeast, vegetable broth, tahini, and lemon juice to the saucepan. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot over injera, rice, or with some crusty bread.

Note: Nuka-pickle recipe: Slice 1 cup of cucumber and layer it in a jar with 1 cup of salt. Let it sit at room temperature for 24 hours. Rinse and drain the cucumber slices and use them in the recipe.
